**7B.8 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mostly **no**. I found a few narrow restraint signals, but the dominant pattern is **tactical reversal, selective compliance, and concealment** around the nuclear file, protest repression, and public accountability. The best positive evidence is procedural and conditional, not durable promise-keeping.

- **Tehran signaled no retaliation after the Isfahan incident** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-19 | https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/ | Reuters said Iran downplayed the strike and indicated it had no retaliation plan, apparently to avert wider war. This is the clearest 2024 positive signal of restraint and short-term promise-consistency, but it was tactical and short-lived. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.2

- **Iran said nuclear weapons were not part of its doctrine** | Reuters via Yahoo News | 2024-04-22 | https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-no-085328983.html | Iran publicly denied a nuclear-weapons role in doctrine, and Reuters noted Khamenei’s long-standing fatwa. This is a real positive signal for formal commitment at the doctrinal level, but it is declaratory rather than proof of sustained compliance. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.1

- **IAEA talks stayed open after Grossi’s visit** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312 | Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This suggests the verification channel remained open, but it does not show Khamenei personally honoring a broader promise to be transparent or consistent. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.6

- **Iran moved toward capping near-weapons-grade uranium stock** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iaeas-grossi-hopes-irans-capping-of-highly-enriched-uranium-stock-holds-3732615 | Reuters reported a conditional move toward capping the stockpile, the strongest concrete restraint step I found. It is a limited positive signal, but it came late and remained conditional rather than a durable, trustworthy commitment. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.6

- **Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA access** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/ | The atomic chief said Iran would not impede IAEA access and would work within safeguards. This is the best late-year pro-compliance signal, but it is narrow, procedural, and late, not evidence of broad honesty about tradeoffs or failures. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.1

- **Khamenei praised the April strike on Israel as proof of power** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-21 | https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/ | Khamenei thanked the armed forces, described the attack as proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. That is strong evidence of opportunistic escalation framing rather than careful consistency with restraint. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.2

- **Inspectors were barred from Iran’s nuclear sites** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087 | Reuters said Iran had removed many experienced inspectors and the IAEA Board demanded reversal. This is strong evidence against good-faith commitment to verification and against transparent handling of sensitive tradeoffs. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7

- **Journalists were still punished for reporting on Amini’s death** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-24 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/24/journalists-ordered-serve-five-years-prison-iran | HRW reported prison sentences for journalists and said the case was framed as propaganda against the state. That is direct evidence of manipulating public information and punishing those who exposed uncomfortable facts. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.7, 7B.6, 7B.2

- **No effective independent investigations into security-force crimes** | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/ | Amnesty said there were no effective, impartial, or independent investigations and that families seeking truth faced harassment and arbitrary detention. This is strong evidence of concealment, non-accountability, and refusal to own tradeoffs or reversals. | **QIDs:** 7B.8, 7B.7, 7B.6, 7B.2

**Search gap**

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence of a specific, documented Khamenei promise that was later openly reversed in a way that could be cleanly traced as a personal breach. The evidence instead shows a broader pattern: **partial tactical restraint in a few moments, paired with sustained concealment, coercive messaging, and noncooperation when scrutiny intensified**.
